message.nenfoundation.bubble_horse.card_: The bubble horse burst. It only converts into a card alive.
message.nenfoundation.bubble_horse.exaus: The bubble horse is spent. Stop hitting it -- a card only comes from one taken alive.
message.nenfoundation.scorpion_leader.al: The sting finds nothing to poison.
message.nenfoundation.scorpion_leader.ve: The venom is already at its peak -- break away and let it drain.
message.nenfoundation.spider_webber.pres: Webbing pins you -- hit the spinneret to tear it free.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.avian_co: It dives to strike and climbs again. On the ground it does not command.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.bat_scou: It does not fight. It sees first and goes back.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.bubble_h: It flees in floating bounds and kicks only when cornered.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.cheetah_: It bursts forward, then slows while it recovers.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.crab_hea: It advances slowly and grabs whoever comes close.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.cyclops: It plants itself and swings a trunk-sized club. It does not turn quickly.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.foxbear: It patrols its territory and presses intruders with its weight. The danger grows when space disappears.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.frog_in_: It stays hidden until movement enters its range.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.great_st: It keeps close distance and advances in a straight line.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.hyper_pu: Nothing, until something hits it from close range.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.king_whi: It charges in a straight line and can overturn when it misses.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.kiriko: It imitates travelers and waits for a hunter to relax.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.man_face: It stays inconspicuous until its target loses caution.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.master_o: It uses water to hide its approach and control space.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.melanin_: It stays still while it is being watched, and moves when it is not.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.mosquito: It comes in from the side, drains, and pulls back.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.multiarm: It chains blows. The last one is the longest.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.radio_ra: It keeps its distance and broadcasts on a cadence.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.scorpion: The stinger is a separate attack, with a longer tell.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.spider_e: It circles above and dives when the moment is right.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.spider_w: It keeps its distance and pins whoever stands still.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.wolf_pac: Roles differ: one holds the front while the others come around.
nenfoundation.bestiary.behavior.wolf_run: It remembers a trail and follows it -- for a while.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.avian_comm: Force it to stay down. While it is low, the squad loses its orders.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.bat_scout: Kill it before the report, or the colony learns where you are.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.bubble_hor: Wear it down and STOP. Killing it cancels the card.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.cheetah_le: Its armour is thin. Punish the tired window.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.crab_heavy: Come from behind. From the front the armour eats the hit.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.cyclops: Circle it. The eye is the weak point AND the sensor -- from the flank you do not exist.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.foxbear: Claw swipes, a bite and a short charge have been observed. Do not let it corner you.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.frog_in_wa: Watch the ground and keep clear of its emergence area.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.great_stam: The charge is dangerous; wait for the opening after it misses.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.hyper_puff: Kill it from a distance. Hitting it up close is what sets off the spores.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.king_white: Turn it over. The belly is the only thing worth hitting.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.man_faced_: Do not mistake a humanoid shape for safety.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.master_of_: Fighting it requires room; shallow water is not safety.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.melanin_li: Do not kill it: the card only comes from one taken alive.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.mosquito_o: Its body is weak. End it fast, before the drain adds up.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.multiarm_c: Wait for the LAST one. Punishing early puts you inside the chain.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.radio_rat: Kill the messenger first. The danger is what it calls.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.scorpion_l: Dodge the STINGER, not the claws. The claws do not poison.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.spider_eag: Open ground helps reveal the dive.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.spider_web: Break the web fast: what kills you is what arrives while you are held.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.wolf_pack_: Kill the leader and the pack changes on the spot -- it does not disperse.
nenfoundation.bestiary.combat.wolf_runne: Break line of sight and wait. The memory expires.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.bat_scout: High ground and night sky around the nest.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.bubble_ho: Open plains, where it has room to bound away.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.cheetah_l: Open ground, where speed is worth something.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.crab_heav: Wherever the colony puts its line.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.king_whit: Old forest floor, under the roots.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.melanin_l: Rock faces and scree, where it is hard to tell it from the stone.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.mosquito_: Above the line, out of reach.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.multiarm_: Tunnels and the mouth of the nest.
nenfoundation.bestiary.habitat.spider_we: Between trunks, where a line can be strung.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.avian_com: It commands from above, and sees the whole field.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.bat_scout: The colony's eye. It reports and flees.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.bubble_ho: An equine carried by bubbles. It only counts alive.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.cheetah_l: The one that arrives first. Speed is its power and its price.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.crab_heav: The one that holds. Its shell faces forward.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.cyclops: A giant with a single eye. It sees a narrow cone and nothing at its sides.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.foxbear: A heavy territorial creature. Read the marks on the ground before crossing a clearing.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.frog_in_w: A buried ambusher waiting for prey to pass.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.great_sta: A charging predator that dominates open ground.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.hyper_puf: A fungus that does not move and does not chase. It waits.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.king_whit: An armoured beetle. The shell does not pay.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.kiriko: A disguised creature that can look human at a distance.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.man_faced: An imitator that uses a familiar silhouette to ambush.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.master_of: A large aquatic predator with a wide territory.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.melanin_l: A lizard that takes the colour of the rock -- and grabs.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.mosquito_: It gets stronger with what it takes.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.multiarm_: Many arms mean many windows, one after another.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.radio_rat: It barely hurts. What it does is tell the others where you are.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.scorpion_: The price of its blow arrives after the blow.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.spider_ea: An aerial hunter that turns height into an advantage.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.spider_we: It binds at range. The danger is not the damage.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.wolf_pack: Alone it backs off. In a pack it surrounds.
nenfoundation.bestiary.summary.wolf_runn: The one that flanks. It wins by arriving, not by hitting.
nenfoundation.divinacao.agua_parada: The water stays still. There is no aura over it.
nenfoundation.divinacao.cor: The water shifts colour. Your category is %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.estranho: Something happens that is on no list. Your category is %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.folha: The leaf drifts across the surface on its own. Your category is %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.impurezas: Specks of matter surface in the water. Your category is %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.repete.cor: The colour shifts again, exactly as before. Still %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.repete.estranho: The same unlisted thing happens again. Still %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.repete.folha: The leaf drifts again, the same way. Still %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.repete.impurezas: The same specks surface again. Still %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.repete.sabor: The taste changes again, exactly as before. Still %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.repete.volume: The water rises again, exactly as before. Still %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.sabor: The water turns sweet on your tongue. Your category is %s.
nenfoundation.divinacao.sem_nen: The water does not react. Awaken your Nen first.
nenfoundation.divinacao.volume: The water rises and overflows. Your category is %s.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.congelamento_a: The NoAI flag is saved inside each entity; this switch is not. If the server restarts while frozen, the enemies come back frozen while the switch reads off. /nenenemy freeze off always sweeps, so it recovers them.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.encontro_armad: Encounter %s armed at %s. It stays ARMED until someone walks within %s blocks -- the controller spawns it, not this command.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.info_sem_contr: this entity is in the mod queue but does not implement HxHEnemy: faction, threat tier and awareness state do not exist for it.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.info_sem_runti: no EnemyRuntime installed: attack phase and stagger do not exist for this mob. Not an error -- mobs born before the foundation keep their own sensors.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.nada_para_remo: No mod enemy within %s blocks. Nothing was removed.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.sem_controlado: No encounter controller alive. It is created when the server starts; run this in a world, not from a menu.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.sem_inimigo_mi: No mod enemy within %s blocks of the crosshair.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.sem_jogador: This subcommand reads the operator's crosshair, so it needs a player. Run it in game, not from the console.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.sem_mira: No block within %s blocks of the crosshair. Aim at a block: the spawn position is measured by the server, never sent by the client.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.sem_receita: No encounter recipe for %s. The encounter would arm and have nothing to place, so nothing was armed.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.spawn_falhou: The server refused to create %s. Nothing was spawned; the reason is in the server log.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.spawn_veio_con: AI is frozen, so what just spawned came in frozen too.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.tipo_desconhec: %s is not a registered enemy of this mod. Nothing was spawned.
nenfoundation.enemy.debug.tipo_fora_do_m: Id outside the mod namespace: %s. Use nenfoundation:<name>; tab completion lists the whole queue.
nenfoundation.error.erro_interno: Failed to process the Nen request. Contact the administrator.
nenfoundation.error.estado_invalido: Your current state does not allow this request.
nenfoundation.error.indisponivel: This action is not available in this version yet.
nenfoundation.error.ja_tem_categoria: This Nen category is already set and cannot be changed.
nenfoundation.error.limite: Too many Nen requests. Please wait a moment.
nenfoundation.error.nao_desbloqueado: You have not unlocked this action yet.
nenfoundation.error.nao_desperto: You have not awakened Nen yet.
nenfoundation.error.output_excedido: Output limit reached for this tick.
nenfoundation.error.ren_necessario: Use Ren over the water to take the test.
nenfoundation.error.sem_categoria: No Nen category has been determined yet.
nenfoundation.error.shu_sem_item: Hold something to wrap with aura.
nenfoundation.ficha.somente_desbloqueios: Received unlocks. In M1, an unlock does not guarantee an executable action.
nenfoundation.vfx.ajuste_automatico: Adjustment %s handed back to the profile.
nenfoundation.vfx.ajuste_forcado: Adjustment %s forced to %s. This is a hypothesis, not a decision: write it to the profile to make it real.
nenfoundation.vfx.captura_desligada: Capture mode off. Camera and HUD restored.
nenfoundation.vfx.captura_falhou: The capture failed. The reason is in the log; nothing was written.
nenfoundation.vfx.captura_ligada: Capture mode ON: time and weather locked, HUD hidden, third person.
nenfoundation.vfx.captura_sem_pasta: Could not create the capture folder: %s. Nothing was written.
nenfoundation.vfx.congelado: Aura FROZEN on the current frame.
nenfoundation.vfx.desenho_desligado: Aura rendering OFF for this client. The technique is still active on the server.
nenfoundation.vfx.desenho_ligado: Aura rendering ON for this client.
nenfoundation.vfx.estado_automatico: Visual state handed back to the server.
nenfoundation.vfx.estado_forcado: Visual state forced to %s. Does not count as capture approval.
nenfoundation.vfx.lod_automatico: Detail level handed back to distance.
nenfoundation.vfx.lod_forcado: Detail level forced to %s for other players.
nenfoundation.vfx.lote_concluido: Batch finished: %s images in screenshots/%s. State handed back to the server.
nenfoundation.vfx.lote_iniciado: Batch started under the label '%s'. Do not move until it finishes.
nenfoundation.vfx.lote_sem_modo: Turn capture mode on before the batch: /nenvfx capture modo on. Without the locks the images LOOK comparable and are not.
nenfoundation.vfx.output_automatico: Visual output handed back to the server.
nenfoundation.vfx.particulas_automatico: Particle density handed back to the config.
nenfoundation.vfx.particulas_forcada: Particle density forced to %s. It was not written to the config.
nenfoundation.vfx.permissivo_ligado: Aura visibility: PERMISSIVE (dev) -- captures taken now are not approval
nenfoundation.vfx.reset: Every aura override on this client was cleared. Rendering follows the server and the profile again.
nenfoundation.vfx.ribbons_automatico: Ribbon count handed back to the profile.
nenfoundation.vfx.tuning_rodape: Nothing here persists. To make it real, write the number in assets/nenfoundation/nen_vfx/.
